{{Quote|Injuries can be faked. Eero was a good actor, nothing more. I was foolish not to think of it before. This should be a lesson to you, Padawan. Have as many friends as you want, but do not trust them. Believe me, I know what I am speaking of.|Dooku, on being betrayed by Eero Iridian|<ref name="LOJ">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
Flexible antennae distinguished members of a tall, spindly [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species'''. The species also had [[Limb/Legends|feet]], [[Color/Legends|bright-yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and shrill voices when concerned. They were members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] and were [[Senator/Legends|represented]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by a [[Eero Iridian's father|senator]]. [[Eero Iridian]], the senator's son, wished to replicate his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] success but twice failed to win the necessary election. Iridian later worked as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Senator [[Blix Annon]] and arranged for his employer's kidnapping. The ploy was one of several abductions that Iridian organized in partnership with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lorian Nod]] to raise funds for another election campaign.

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had a tall, spindly physique. It was distinguished by [[Color/Legends|bright-yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and flexible antennae. Nervous members of the species twirled these antennae around their fingers, and publicly embarrassed ones visibly bristled. The species had [[Limb/Legends|feet]]. Their skin became pale when injured, and they had a shrill voice when scared.<ref name="LOJ" />

==Society and culture==
The species recognized [[Parent/Legends|father]]&ndash;son ties. At least some members of the species wore clothes.<ref name="LOJ" />

==History==
{{Quote|I myself arranged the security upgrades. I chose the most renowned company for vessel security&mdash;Kontag. I have an extensive file on them, I did my research.|Eero Iridian, on setting up the kidnapping of Senator Annon|<ref name="LOJ" />}}
The species was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] prior to the government's [[New Order/Legends|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Eero Iridian's father|member]] of the species attained the post of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During the Senator's tenure, his son, [[Eero Iridian]], became a [[senatorial aide]] with the goal of following in his father's footsteps.<ref name="LOJ" /> Around [[90 BBY/Legends|90 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE" /> Iridian presented a paper on the [[Politics/Legends|political]] history of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] but was publicly corrected by the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The pair became friends, trading favors during their careers. The Senator eventually retired from politics, having depleted his family's wealth.<ref name="LOJ" />

[[File:Youngdooku.jpg|thumb|right|Dooku and Qui-Gon Jinn captured Eero Iridian.]]
Iridian twice ran unsuccessfully for election as his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] senator but became stymied by a lack of funds. He dropped out of public life, eventually taking a position as [[Aide/Legends|aide]] for [[Blix Annon]],<ref name="LOJ" /> an important senator with strong support within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CSWE Blix">{{CSWECite|I|32|Annon, Blix}}</ref> Frustrated at his lackluster career, Iridian collaborated with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lorian Nod]], arranging the kidnappings of numerous senators. The funds from the ransoms were to be used to fund another election campaign. Iridian ultimately arranged for the capture of Annon, and a successful kidnapping attempt was made while Iridian accompanied the Senator on a cruise to Annon's [[Blix Annon's homeworld|homeworld]]. Iridian feigned injury to his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escorts&mdash;Dooku and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. He later set them up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Von-Alai]], leading to their capture by Nod. The kidnapping attempt went awry when Annon [[Death/Legends|died]] of a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] attack. Iridian panicked, providing an opportunity for Dooku to turn the tables on Nod. Iridian was eventually handed over to the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]<ref name="LOJ" /> to stand trial for murder and conspiracy.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eero Iridian's species was created by [[Jude Watson]], author of the novel ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'', which was published in [[2003]].<ref name="LOJ" />
